Community garden workshops

Learn practical growing skills

Community gardeners learn seasonal planting, soil preparation, composting, watering, pest prevention, harvesting, crop rotation, seed selection, and accessible garden design. Our instructors demonstrate each skill and help neighbors practice safely. Every workshop includes printed guidance, local planting calendars, hands-on activities, questions, and follow-up resources. Participants can attend beginner sessions, family sessions, volunteer days, and advanced growing clinics. The program connects residents with shared tools, raised beds, seeds, mentors, and welcoming outdoor spaces. Members leave with a realistic plan for growing food at home or contributing to a neighborhood plot. Registration supports supplies and keeps community learning affordable for local families throughout the growing season.
